label: download rustup-init
command:
download rustup-init [skipped if <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/downloads/rustup-init exists]
    (cd <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/downloads && timeout --kill-after=60 21600 taskset --cpu-list 8-11,40-43 nice -n 10 curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --output <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/downloads/rustup-init.part https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/archive/1.29.3/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init)

label: rustup-init
command:
rustup-init [skipped if <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/switches/rust/.upgrade_builds-done exists] [first empties <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/switches/rust]
    (cd <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/downloads && RUSTUP_HOME=<bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/switches/rust/rustup CARGO_HOME=<bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/switches/rust/cargo PATH=<bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/switches/rust/cargo/bin:"$PATH" timeout --kill-after=60 21600 taskset --cpu-list 8-11,40-43 nice -n 10 <bench-workdir>/exp/13-upgrade-builds-df/work/downloads/rustup-init -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain none)
